title: texture.status
description: Whether the client draws the world with its own art (its generated pack), against which slot map, and what it lacks.

missing.description: Slot-map keys whose sprite this client lacks (drawn as placeholders).

shapes.description: Shape ids this client has geometry for; 0 while it draws cubes.

shapeIndexHash.description: The shape index it built them from.

packs.description: Texture-pack manifests this client applied (omitted when none).

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
